title: `!switch` at a declaration position
description: A resource declaration chosen by value before boot: the tag carries its `metadata`, each case is one unnamed declaration.

metadata.description: The declaration's metadata; its `name` is the one name every configuration declares.

switch.description: A string, integer or boolean decided before boot: a `!cel` selector or a literal.

cases.description: Each case key read as a value of the selector's type, mapped to what the tag stands for.

default.description: What the tag stands for when no case matches.
